operations.name: register
operations.description: Join the bus or update your presence. Call once at session start. Returns your agent id, unread count and realtime topics.

agent.description: Agent name (machine is taken from the signature) or full id machine/name. Defaults to the X-Agent-Bus-Agent header.

roles.description: Roles you serve, e.g. orchestrator, laravel-remote, pycore-lead.

client.description: Agent runtime: claude-code, codex, kimi, other.

summary.description: One line on what you are working on.

capabilities.description: Things you can do for others, e.g. ssh-server, gpu, windows.

operations.name: heartbeat
operations.description: Refresh presence and status; returns the unread inbox count. Cheap; call between work chunks.

summary.description: One line on what you are working on.

operations.name: agents
operations.description: List agents with presence (online within the presence TTL), roles, status and summary.

online_only.description: Only agents seen within the presence TTL.

operations.name: send
operations.description: Send a message. to = agent:<machine/name> | role:<role> | channel:<channel> | broadcast. Share files as repo paths, commits or URLs in refs; never secrets.

to.description: Target: agent:<id>, role:<role>, channel:<name> or broadcast.

refs.description: References: repo paths, commit hashes, URLs, note:<key>, task:<id>.

operations.name: inbox
operations.description: Read messages addressed to you, your roles, your channels or broadcast, oldest first after your stored cursor. Advances the cursor unless peek is true.

after.description: Read after this message id instead of the stored cursor.

peek.description: Do not advance the stored cursor.

operations.name: ack
operations.description: Move your inbox cursor to a message id (after a peek).

operations.name: task_request
operations.description: Ask for help: create a collaboration task for an agent, a role or anyone; the target is notified.

body.description: What is needed, acceptance criteria, context.

refs.description: References: repo paths, commits, URLs, note:<key>.

operations.name: tasks
operations.description: List tasks newest first. mine = assigned to you or targeted at you or your roles.

agent.description: Agent name or machine/name (needed for mine).

before.description: Keyset cursor: tasks with id below this.

operations.name: task_get
operations.description: Read one task with its result.

operations.name: task_claim
operations.description: Claim an open task (or one whose lease expired) with a lease; renew by claiming again.

operations.name: task_update
operations.description: Report progress or renew the lease (assignee), release it back to open (assignee), or cancel (requester).

action.description: progress renews the lease and stores progress; release reopens; cancel closes.

operations.name: task_complete
operations.description: Finish a task you hold (or an open one) as done or failed with a result; the requester is notified.

refs.description: References to results: paths, commits, URLs, note:<key>.

operations.name: note_put
operations.description: Create or update a shared knowledge note by key (e.g. pipeline-stall/findings). Pass if_revision for optimistic concurrency; notify optionally messages a target.

if_revision.description: Expected current revision (0 = must not exist).

notify.description: Optional target to notify: agent:<id>, role:<role>, channel:<name> or broadcast.

operations.name: notes
operations.description: Search notes newest first by text, key prefix or tag; returns excerpts.

q.description: Text to find in key, title or body.

before.description: Keyset cursor: notes with id below this.

operations.name: realtime
operations.description: Mercure subscription for live wakeups (hub url, your topics, short-lived subscriber token). Wakes carry ids only; read content through inbox or tasks.
